_comment: The ONE table of e2e rows, in run order (e2e/e2e-env.py plan reads it; e2e/run.sh runs the plan; TESTING.md lists it). 'yaml' is the Maestro flow in e2e/flows/ the row runs (several rows share one generic flow: the link and the expectations come from the runner). 'kind': local (no key, no click), deferred (real click, token staged, backend install check), problistic (real click, nothing staged), reengagement (fresh install, then the link opens the app), reopen (installed through the link first, then the link opens the installed app), reward (deferred install, then the reward's events), event (trackEvent). 'slot' is the link slot from e2e/e2e-env.json (reward rows use reward_links, reopen rows only their link type's link). 'link_type_matrix': the row also runs once per link type as <flow>__<type> on that type's link; 'link_type_only': only those rows. 'expected' says what the flow and the backend check assert.

flows.expected: the consent sheet commits Allow tracking
the consent sheet commits Deny; no link delivered
onLink once, source deferred, the link's path + voucher; backend: recorded, attributed, click_token, 1 install, not fraud
no onLink; backend: not recorded, 0 installs

onLink once, source deferred, voucher; backend: recorded, attributed, click_token, 1 install, not fraud. Per link type also customData linkType/source, linkType on the backend, and the reward: per_install earned on rewarded types, reward null and 0 on the others
no onLink; backend: not recorded, 0 installs. Per link type also linkType on the backend and nothing earned
no token staged; allow sends the install and the app gets its attribution answer. Backend device lookup: not checkable (the plugin exposes no SDK device id)
no token staged; deny sends nothing: no attribution, no onLink; backend: the click has 0 installs
no token staged; allow sends the install and the app gets its attribution answer. Backend device lookup: not checkable (the plugin exposes no SDK device id)
no token staged; deny sends nothing: no attribution, no onLink; backend: the click has 0 installs
allow, then the link opens the app (Android App Link, iOS handleDeepLink): onLink once, source reengagement, path + voucher
deny, then the link still routes (route-only): onLink once, source reengagement, path + voucher

installed through the type's link (deferred allow, backend install + reward checked), restarted, then the link opens the app: onLink source reengagement + linkType; backend openCount +1, installCount and earning unchanged (no second reward)
installed through the type's link with deny (nothing recorded), restarted, then the link routes: onLink source reengagement; backend openCount, installCount and earning unchanged
counted install on the per_event link, then reward.eventName x2 + 1 other event, all attributed; earning 2 x reward.amountMinor; events byName/count match
deny on the per_event link, the same events are dropped by the SDK; earning 0, events count 0
counted install on the rev_share link, then 1 revenue event in the reward currency + 1 in another currency, attributed; earning floor(revenue x rateBps / 10000); events revenue matches
deny on the rev_share link, the same events are dropped by the SDK; earning 0, events count 0
allow, then trackEvent(e2e_purchase, 9.99 USD) is accepted
